# FDG7027

> DO NOT exclude any special exceptions when catching for the purpose of transferring exceptions.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.2.2 Exception Handling.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Analyzer candidate rejected: the purpose of a catch (transferring the exception) cannot be told from syntax, and the body's pattern, a conditional rethrow of special types, is legitimate in a catch that does not transfer. CA1031 does not report the body's example, since its block throws (probe with SDK 10.0.402).

## From the book

```csharp
catch (Exception e) {
   // bad code
   // do not do this!
   if (e is OutOfMemoryException ||
       e is AccessViolationException
   ) throw;
    ...
}
```
